T. A. Movsessian, T. Yu. Magakian, A. V. Moiseev

We present long-slit spectroscopic observations of the outflow associated with an infrared source IRAS 01166+6635, conducted with the 6-m telescope of the Special Astrophysical Observatory using the SCORPIO-2 focal reducer. The structure of the flow as investigated in detail, its position-velocity diagrams are constructed. The electron densities of the several knots in the outflow were estimated, revealing a decrease in its density with increasing distance from the driving source.
